name: Crimson V
original_name: Crimson V -クリムゾンヴィー-
source:
Play as Makoto, a red-haired, tan-skinned vampire attending missionary school in Europe. You are invited in. Roam among your classmates as a predator among its prey.

Boys love game.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE067181.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
扮演红发、褐肤的吸血鬼马科托，他在欧洲的一所教会学校就读。你应邀进入其中，在同学之间游走，如同捕食者徘徊在猎物之间。

一款男男恋爱游戏。

［摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE067181.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
